read.thesis: Q4 sales fell 2% and Operating EBITDA 15% on shifted seed and crop protection deliveries, while FY26 guide of $4.0–4.2B EBITDA (+7% midpoint) rests on volume, with Latin America and Asia pricing still pressured.

triggers.label: Crop protection price down 1% in Q4
triggers.quote: Crop Protection price was down 1% driven largely by competitive pricing dynamics in Latin America and partially offset by price/mix increases in North America.

triggers.label: FY26 EBITDA $4.0–4.2B, +7% midpoint
triggers.quote: For the full year 2026, Corteva expects operating EBITDA1 to be $4.0 billion to $4.2 billion, growth of 7% at the mid-point.

triggers.label: Bayer litigation resolved, royalty neutrality 2026
triggers.quote: Agreement helps accelerate Corteva’s path to royalty neutrality to 2026, two years earlier than previously expected

guidance.quote: Corteva expects operating EBITDA1 to be $4.0 billion to $4.2 billion, growth of 7% at the mid-point.
Operating EPS1 is expected to be $3.45 to $3.70 per share, growth of 7% at the mid-point.
The company expects to record approximately $80 million to $90 million net pre-tax restructuring charges during 2026

red_flags.label: Q4 operating EBITDA down 15%, crop protection down 22%
red_flags.quote: Segment operating EBITDA was $360 million in the fourth quarter of 2025, down 22% from the fourth quarter of 2024.
